subject: music
title: Modulation and Voice Leading
welcome_lead: How to move from one key to another — smoothly.
meta_desc: A-Level Music: modulation techniques and voice-leading rules.
final_note: Smooth voice leading is the composer's invisible skill.

walkthroughs.body_html: Pivot-chord modulation reinterprets a chord as functioning in the new key. Chromatic uses an altered chord to wrench the harmony. Common-tone links via a single pitch.
Move each voice the shortest distance. Avoid parallel fifths and parallel octaves. Resolve the leading tone up to tonic and the seventh down by step.
To modulate from C to G: use Am (vi in C = ii in G) as pivot, then ii-V-I in G. Smooth voice leading keeps the modulation seamless.
